text: I've given you what I can... the rest is up to you. {name}, my child, there's a new life waiting for you. Good luck.

She reaches for you, and her hands are the last gentle thing you feel. Then a blinding light bursts from the goddess and strikes you like a wave. The dark tears past like black water as you are thrown backward through it, faster and faster, with no time to breathe, no time to understand.
